notes: Posted 8 June 2001 with no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No starting section is posted; the strategy starts Profit, Han Solo (imprisoned), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection, Staging Areas and a third Effect chosen by matchup (Ultimatum, The Camp or Aim High). All are in the normal sections and count toward the 60; no single starting Effect is named, so none is set.

Posted 'tatoonie jabbas palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'tatoonie docking bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'cloud city platform 327(docking bay)' the Light Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay).

Posted 'JPSD lando' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax (the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Lando); 'R2&3PO' the Reflections II combo character Artoo & Threepio; 'EPP han' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'EPP leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'ECC chewie' Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'LS,JK' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight.

Posted 'dont get @#$%y' dested Don't Get Cocky; 'sorry about the mess%blaster prof.' the combo Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'how did we get into this mess' How Did We Get Into This Mess?; Weapon Levitation the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.

Insurrection, Aim High and Staging Areas are posted as separate lines and dested the single Effects (the strategy starts Insurrection and Staging Areas and treats Aim High as a separate third Effect).
